"# Insurtech Partner Integration SDK — Technical Specification & Implementation Plan

## Goal Description

Build a production-grade TypeScript monorepo (using **Yarn Workspaces**) for an Insurtech Partner Integration SDK that enables insurance partners to seamlessly embed claim submission, document upload, and claim status tracking into their applications.

The repository consists of three workspace packages and an examples suite:
1. **`@insurtech/common`** (`packages/common`): Shared TypeScript interfaces, DTOs, enums/literal unions, and field validation schemas/helpers shared between the Mock API Server and the SDK.
2. **`@insurtech/mock-api`** (`packages/mock-api`): Stateful in-memory HTTP server implementing the 6 required REST endpoints with JWT authentication, field-level request validation (HTTP 400), realistic latency simulation (200–500ms), and transient failure simulation (~10% HTTP 503).
3. **`@insurtech/sdk`** (`packages/sdk`): Partner-facing TypeScript SDK featuring pre-flight client-side validation, automatic JWT acquisition & refresh, exponential backoff retry logic for 503/network failures, upload progress reporting (`onProgress`), status polling (`onStatusChange`), and strongly typed error classes (`ValidationError`, `AuthError`, `NetworkError`, `ApiError`).
4. **Examples & Documentation** (`examples/`, `README.md`): 3 end-to-end runnable integration scripts and complete developer documentation.
